result.description:
About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Backup & Storage Administrator to join our Managed Services team supporting mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure and enterprise platforms. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, maintenance, optimization, and lifecycle management of enterprise backup and storage environments, ensuring high availability, performance, data protection, business continuity, and disaster recovery in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Key Responsibilities: 

Storage Administration: 
Administer and support enterprise storage environments across Production, UAT, Development, Test, and Disaster Recovery environments.
Manage SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and enterprise storage infrastructure.
Perform storage provisioning, LUN allocation, zoning, masking, expansion, and capacity management.
Monitor storage health, performance, utilization, and availability using enterprise monitoring tools.
Perform storage performance tuning and optimization.
Support storage replication, snapshots, cloning, and disaster recovery solutions.
Perform firmware upgrades, storage migrations, lifecycle management, and maintenance activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve storage-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.

Backup Administration:
Administer and support enterprise backup infrastructure.
Configure and manage backup policies, schedules, retention policies, and media management.
Monitor backup jobs and ensure successful completion of backup and restore operations.
Perform backup recovery testing and validation.
Manage backup replication between Production and Disaster Recovery environments.
Perform backup infrastructure upgrades, patching, and maintenance.
Support disaster recovery exercises and business continuity testing.
Troubleshoot failed backup jobs and optimize backup performance.
Ensure backup compliance with security, governance, and retention requirements.

Operational Support:
Collaborate with Database, VMware, Linux, Windows, Network, Security, and Application Support teams.
Participate in Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Capacity Management processes following ITIL best practices.
Develop operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
Ensure compliance with operational procedures, security standards, and governance requirements.
Identify automation opportunities and implement continuous service improvements.
Participate in planned maintenance activities and 24x7 on-call support rotations.

Required Experience:
Minimum 4 years of experience in Enterprise Backup and Storage Administration.
Experience working within Managed Services or Enterprise Infrastructure Operations.
Experience supporting large-scale enterprise backup and storage environments.
Experience working in mission-critical production environments with strict SLA and KPI commitments.
Experience supporting Telecommunications, Service Providers, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable.
Experience working in 24x7 operational support environments.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: From $90,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation

At Bowhill Engineering, we don't just build steel structures—we transform communities by optimising and building structures that matter.

About the Role
As a Robotic Welder Trade Assistant, you'll support our robotic welding operations by preparing materials, assisting production, moving components and helping keep projects running safely, efficiently and on schedule.
This is an ideal opportunity for someone wanting to begin a career in manufacturing, fabrication or robotics while learning from experienced tradespeople.

You'll be involved in a variety of tasks including:
Assisting our Robotic Metal Fabricators with daily production activities

Inspecting work and helping maintain quality standards

Contributing ideas for continuous improvement

Keen to learn new skills

Safety focused
Positive and team orientated
Takes pride in producing quality work
Comfortable working in a busy manufacturing environment 

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

White Card

At Bowhill Engineering, we're proud of our people, our projects and the communities we help build.
When you join our team, you'll enjoy:
Full-time, permanent employment
On-the-job training and development
Opportunities to grow your career within advanced manufacturing

A supportive team environment
A company that values honesty, teamwork, respect and continuous improvement
The opportunity to contribute to major infrastructure and structural steel projects across Australia 
Together we thrive.
If you're ready to learn, work hard and be part of a team building structures that matter, we'd love to hear from you.

Dubbo Grain Packing (DGP)
Grain Storage & Handling Site, Trangie, NSW 2823

Full Time General Clerk
$98,000 per annum plus superannuation

Summary
The General Clerk provides administrative and clerical support to the operations of Dubbo
Grain Packing (DGP). The position is responsible for maintaining records, processing
documentation, data entry, preparing correspondence, coordinating office activities, and
supporting grain storage and handling operations through efficient administrative services.

Duties and Responsibilities

General Administrative Support
•	Perform a range of clerical and administrative duties to support site operations.
•	Prepare, process and file business documents, forms and correspondence.
•	Maintain electronic and physical filing systems.
•	Receive, sort and distribute incoming mail and communications.
•	Assist management with routine administrative tasks.

Record Keeping and Data Entry
•	Enter and update operational information into company databases and record systems.
•	Maintain records relating to grain receivals, dispatches and inventory movements.
•	Verify information for accuracy and completeness.
•	Retrieve records and documents as requested by management.
•	Ensure records are maintained in accordance with company procedures.

Document Preparation
•	Prepare routine reports, spreadsheets, forms and correspondence.
•	Compile operational data for management reporting purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of meeting agendas, minutes and administrative documentation.
•	Maintain document registers and administrative records.

Customer and Stakeholder Liaison
•	Respond to routine enquiries from customers, suppliers, transport operators and
•	contractors.
•	Direct enquiries to appropriate personnel when required.
•	Provide administrative support to visitors and site personnel.
•	Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Operational Administration Support
•	Assist with processing grain receival and dispatch documentation.
•	Maintain weighbridge and transport records.
•	Support scheduling and coordination of administrative activities during harvest periods.
•	Assist operational staff with document management and record maintenance.

Compliance Administration
•	Maintain records required for workplace health and safety, training and compliance
•	purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of documentation for audits and inspections.
•	Ensure administrative records are current, accurate and readily accessible.
•	Support implementation of company policies and procedures.

Reporting
•	Prepare routine administrative and operational reports.
•	Compile statistical information and summaries as requested by management.
•	Assist with monitoring and reporting of administrative activities.

Skills and Competencies
•	Strong administrative and clerical skills.
•	Accurate data entry and record management capability.
•	Sound computer and office software skills.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills.
•	Effective written and verbal communication skills.
•	Attention to detail and accuracy.

Qualifications and Experience
•	Certificate III, Certificate IV or higher qualification in Business Administration or a related field; or
•	At least one year of relevant clerical or administrative experience.
•	At least 12 months experience with a program called Agtech and Agri-digital.

result.description:
Location: Foster, VIC, 3960
Full-Time: Immediate start
Job Title: Residential Care Officer
Salary range: $79,500 to $85,0000 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client, a respected 70-bed not-for-profit residential aged care facility in Foster, we are seeking a dedicated Residential Care Officer. Guided by a community board and a mission to provide a dignified life for all in their care, our client is deeply committed to “listening and learning, finding a better way, working as a team, and acting with kindness.” In this role, you will be instrumental in translating these values into daily action, moving beyond generic support to deliver tailored, high-quality care that enhances the wellbeing of every resident.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Holistic Resident Assessment & Individual Planning
• Thoroughly assess each resident’s physical, emotional, and social needs upon admission and throughout their stay, identifying specific difficulties related to ageing, mobility, or cognition.
• Develop, implement, and continuously evaluate personalised educational, training, and support programs that promote independence and a dignified quality of life.

Care Coordination & Family Support
• Support families by providing clear education on aged care processes, actively involving them in care decisions, and assisting residents with daily living activities within the secure, group housing environment.
• Closely monitor each resident’s progress, documenting changes in condition or behaviour, and prepare detailed reports for clinical teams and family members.

Community & Resource Liaison
• Identify additional services required by residents (e.g., specialist physiotherapy, podiatry, or dementia support) and make professional referrals to external agencies that can provide this supplementary help.
• Liaise with local community groups, welfare agencies, and government bodies in the Foster region to assess available health, housing, and support resources, promoting awareness of these services to residents and their families.

Emotional & Problem-Solving Support
• Actively listen to and assist residents in resolving social, emotional, or financial concerns that may affect their wellbeing, always acting with kindness and a collaborative approach.
• Prepare clear, compliant funding submissions and progress reports for government bodies and other agencies, ensuring the facility continues to adapt to the changing aged-care landscape.

Requirements (Essential)
• Relevant qualifications in Aged Care, Community Services, or equivalent (e.g., Certificate IV in Aged Care or Diploma of Community Services).
• Demonstrated at least 1 year+ of full-time experience in residential aged care, including assessment, care planning, and documentation.
• Strong ability to work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team, upholding values of respect and continuous improvement.
• Excellent interpersonal skills to support families, liaise with external agencies, and advocate for residents’ needs.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
